data.title: Deep Dive Analysis: 2026-01-02
data.summary: Comprehensive codebase analysis identifying critical issues, coverage gaps, and recommended next steps

sections.System Health Status: Smoke Tests: 34/34 PASSING (1.76s). Unit+Smoke Coverage: 84%. Git: Clean working tree. All core systems operational: CorticalTextProcessor, GoT, CDG, CEL, Spark SLM, Hubris micro-experts.
sections.Critical Issues: 2 CRITICAL bugs in GoT: (1) Transaction-unsafe delete operations bypass WAL - crash during delete creates orphaned edges (api.py:661-711, 808-862). (2) Potential deadlock in versioned_store.py:51-84 - two ProcessLocks with no defined acquisition order. Coverage gaps: prism_causal.py at 0%, prism_attention.py at 15%.
sections.Recommended Next Steps: PRIORITY ORDER: 1. Fix 2 critical GoT bugs (transaction-unsafe delete, potential deadlock). 2. Complete Test Health Restoration sprint (2 tasks remaining). 3. Add tests for prism_causal.py (0% coverage). 4. Add tests for prism_attention.py (15% coverage). 5. Run full contract test suite verification.
